page.description: Start scanning immediately. Project selection is only required when promoting to the data lake.

errors.loadFailed: Failed to load scan intake page.

agent.offlineDescription: Install and start Sohoa Scan Agent v2 on this computer to use the scanner.
agent.needV2: Scan Agent v2 is required (POST /scan). Rebuild from the latest source and restart SohoaScanAgent.exe.
agent.noTwainDescription: Plustek drivers are usually visible only to the 32-bit (win-x86) Agent build.
agent.step1: Download and extract SohoaScanAgent, then run SohoaScanAgent.exe
agent.step2: Install the Plustek TWAIN driver if you have not already

documents.title: PDF documents
documents.empty: Add a document to scan pages into.

pages.selectDocument: Select a document to view and scan pages.
pages.scanCancelled: Scan cancelled or ADF feeder is empty
pages.scanFailed: Scan failed. Check Scan Agent v2 and TWAIN driver.
pages.empty: No pages yet. Click Scan page to capture from the scanner.
pages.savePdfSuccess: Pages merged to PDF on MinIO
pages.reorderSuccess: Page order updated. Click Save PDF to refresh the draft file.
pages.reorderFailed: Could not reorder pages. Please refresh the page.

organize.inboxEmpty: No saved PDFs in inbox yet.
organize.foldersEmpty: Create a folder and drag PDFs into it.
organize.dragHint: Drag PDFs onto the folder tree on the right to group them into dossiers.
organize.treeHint: Click + on a folder to create a subfolder. A folder may contain direct PDFs or subfolders — not both.
organize.movedToInbox: PDF moved back to unorganized list
organize.inboxDropHint: Drag PDFs here to remove them from a folder.
organize.selectHint: Check PDFs or folders to promote.
organize.multiSelectHint: Select multiple PDFs or multiple folders — not both at once.
organize.mixedSelectionBlocked: Cannot mix PDF and folder selection. Clear the other type first.
organize.folderEmptyPromote: This folder has no PDFs yet. Drag PDFs from the inbox into the folder before promoting.
organize.mixedFolder: Invalid structure: folder «{{folder}}» cannot contain both direct PDFs and subfolders with PDFs.

promote.hint: Choose a project and target folder on MinIO to push selected PDFs to raw/.
promote.targetFolderRequired: Select a target folder on MinIO
promote.loadFoldersFailed: Could not load the project folder tree.
promote.selectFolderHint: Select a folder in the tree (same as Data Management).
promote.selectFolderOnly: Select a folder or dossier with a MinIO path — not a child PDF file.
promote.nothingSelected: No folder or PDF selected to promote

errors.mixedFolderDestination: Invalid target folder: it cannot contain both direct PDF files and subfolders with PDFs. Choose a specific subfolder or fix the structure before promoting.

commit.descriptionSelected: Promote {{count}} selected PDF(s) to a raw/ folder on MinIO.
commit.descriptionFolder: Promote the entire folder «{{folder}}» ({{count}} PDF(s)) to MinIO, preserving subfolder structure.
commit.descriptionFolders: Promote {{count}} PDF(s) from {{folderCount}} selected folders to MinIO, preserving subfolder structure.
